_about: NFL trades and key roster moves, Oct 27 to Nov 11, 2026 (trade deadline window, deadline Nov 10 4 PM ET), researched Nov 11, 2026 for the Week 10 card (Trina: call out the trades on every game card and factor them in). Every move has a dated source. role_now is the role this week. slot is the lineup slot used by lineups.py. already_in_data true means the player has played for his new team already, so the ratings and snap counts carry the move.

moves.impact: Downs (9 games for Indianapolis, rating 69) slots in as Kansas City's slot receiver with Xavier Worthy day to day, which moves Jalen Royals down the depth chart.
moves.source: ESPN, Chiefs snag needed help at WR, trade for Colts' Josh Downs (Nov 10, 2026), espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445576; theScore trade tracker (Nov 10)

moves.impact: Indianapolis loses its slot receiver on the same day it traded Keenan Allen, with Alec Pierce already on IR, so its receiver room is down to depth players.
moves.source: ESPN (Nov 10, 2026), espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445576; theScore trade tracker (Nov 10)

moves.impact: Allen joins a receiver room missing Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel (hamstring), Ricky Pearsall and Christian Kirk, and should play slot and outside snaps right away.
moves.source: ESPN, 49ers trade for Colts' Keenan Allen (Nov 10, 2026), espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444457; NFL.com, Colts trade WR Keenan Allen to 49ers for 2027 sixth-round pick

moves.impact: Indianapolis loses its second veteran receiver in one day, leaving the passing game with few proven targets for this game.
moves.source: ESPN (Nov 10, 2026), espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444457; theScore trade tracker (Nov 10)

moves.impact: Hooker (rating 99 at safety) replaces Damar Hamlin next to Cole Bishop, a clear upgrade for a Buffalo pass defense that needed a safety.
moves.source: buffalobills.com, Bills land impact safety Amani Hooker in trade with Titans (Nov 10, 2026); ESPN, espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444810

moves.impact: Tennessee loses its best rated safety twelve days after trading Jeffery Simmons, so a backup safety starts against Jacksonville.
moves.source: buffalobills.com (Nov 10, 2026); theScore trade tracker (Nov 10)

moves.impact: Cisco adds safety depth behind Brian Branch and Chuck Clark while Kerby Joseph is out; he is not expected to start in Munich.
moves.source: newyorkjets.com, Jets acquire 2028 6th round pick in trade of Andre Cisco to Lions (Nov 9, 2026); ESPN trade grades (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Cisco played 0 to 14% of New York's defensive snaps the last three games, so his exit changes little for the Jets against Buffalo.
moves.source: newyorkjets.com (Nov 9, 2026); nflverse snap counts

moves.impact: Bates (rating 81) replaces Eric Murray (out for the season) at safety next to Antonio Johnson.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 9, 2026); NFL.com news roundup Monday Nov 9, 2026; ESPN trade grades (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Atlanta loses its starting free safety (every snap the last three games), so a backup starts next to Xavier Watts against Patrick Mahomes.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 9, 2026); NFL.com news roundup Monday Nov 9, 2026

moves.impact: Davis adds a run stopping tackle who played 57 to 65% of Philadelphia's snaps, deepening the Jacksonville interior after DaVon Hamilton's season ending injury.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 9, 2026); SI trade tracker (updated Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Godchaux is in line for the nose tackle snaps DaVon Hamilton left, but he played only 10 to 28% of New Orleans' snaps.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 9, 2026); ESPN trade grades (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Godchaux was a rotation tackle for New Orleans, so his exit thins the interior line only a little against Carolina.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 9, 2026); nflverse snap counts

moves.impact: Neuzil gives Baltimore a second center with Ethan Pocic on IR; it is not yet set whether he starts or Cam Jurgens moves to guard.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 10, 2026); ESPN trade grades (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Atlanta trades its starting center (every snap the last three games); backup Corey Levin is expected to start against Kansas City's front.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 10, 2026); ESPN trade grades (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Vorhees arrives as depth at guard and is not expected to start this week.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 10, 2026); ESPN trade grades (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Vorhees did not play an offensive snap in Week 9, so Baltimore's line is unchanged by his exit.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 10, 2026); nflverse snap counts

moves.impact: Cousins (rating 69, nine starts for Las Vegas) is expected to start at Green Bay ahead of Kyler Murray (hamstring, rating 33) and Carson Wentz, though Kevin O'Connell has not formally named him.
moves.source: CBS Minnesota, Vikings reuniting with QB Kirk Cousins after trade with Raiders (Nov 10, 2026); NFL.com, Vikings won't commit to Kirk Cousins starting vs. Packers (Nov 11, 2026); Heavy (Nov 11, 2026)

moves.impact: Las Vegas trades its season starter; No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza (one relief appearance, 8 passes) makes his first start against Seattle.
moves.source: NFL.com, Vikings trade for Raiders QB Kirk Cousins on deadline day (Nov 10, 2026); raiders.com, Raiders acquire 2027 third-round pick for QB Kirk Cousins; DK Network Week 10 injury report (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Brissett is expected to start for Baltimore with Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley on IR, replacing undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano, who started Week 9.
moves.source: KOLD, Arizona Cardinals trade QB Brissett to Baltimore Ravens for draft picks (Nov 6, 2026); NFL.com news roundup Monday Nov 9, 2026 (Jesse Minter: Brissett expected to start)

moves.impact: Brissett had already been benched for Gardner Minshew, so the trade itself changes little; with Minshew now on IR, rookie Carson Beck starts against the Rams.
moves.source: KOLD (Nov 6, 2026); theScore trade tracker (Nov 6)

moves.impact: The Chargers trade a starting linebacker who played 72 to 90% of their snaps, so a backup linebacker plays more against Baltimore's run game.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Nov 10, 2026); ESPN trade grades (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: The Rams lose their top receiver (rating 99) for at least four games with Davante Adams also on IR, leaving Konata Mumpfield and Tutu Atwell as the lead receivers.
moves.source: SI Rams On SI, Rams Lose Puka Nacua to Injured Reserve (Nov 9, 2026); NFL.com news roundup Monday Nov 9, 2026

moves.impact: Miami's starter is out at least four games with a groin injury, so Kyle McCord makes his first NFL start at Indianapolis.
moves.source: ESPN, Dolphins put Willis on IR with groin injury (Nov 10, 2026), espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445819; Yahoo Sports (Nov 10, 2026): McCord expected to start vs. Colts

moves.impact: Miami loses its best interior pass rusher (rating 82) for the season with a ruptured biceps.
moves.source: ESPN (Nov 10, 2026), espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50445819; WPBF (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Minshew (elbow, likely season ending) goes to IR, so rookie Carson Beck makes his first start with 40 year old Josh Johnson signed as his backup.
moves.source: Washington Post, Cardinals place QB Gardner Minshew on injured reserve, opening the door for rookie Carson Beck (Nov 10, 2026); azfamily (Nov 11, 2026); ClutchPoints, Carson Beck officially confirmed as QB1 for Rams clash

moves.impact: Arizona's top receiver (rating 88) is out for the season with a neck injury, so the rookie quarterback throws to Reggie Virgil, Simi Fehoko and Devin Duvernay.
moves.source: NFL.com news roundup Monday Nov 9, 2026; DK Network Week 10 injury report (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Palmer (hamstring) was a part time receiver (9 to 25% of snaps lately), so Buffalo's starting receivers are unchanged.
moves.source: NFL.com news roundup Monday Nov 9, 2026; DK Network Week 10 injury report (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Nelson started at left guard after the trade but is week to week after a minor knee procedure, so Grey Zabel moves back to left guard.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Oct 27, 2026); DK Network Week 10 injury report (Nov 10, 2026)

moves.impact: Indianapolis has played two games without its All Pro guard, so the ratings already carry the loss.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Oct 27, 2026); abc7chicago trade tracker (Nov 2, 2026)

moves.impact: Buckner has already played for San Francisco and gives the pass rush an interior starter while Nick Bosa is out.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Oct 27, 2026); abc7chicago trade tracker (Nov 2, 2026)

moves.impact: Indianapolis has played without Buckner since Week 8, so the ratings already carry the loss of its best interior rusher.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Oct 27, 2026)

moves.impact: Tennessee's best defender (rating 97) is gone and has not played for the Titans since Week 7, so the ratings already carry most of the loss.
moves.source: theScore trade tracker (Oct 29, 2026); abc7chicago trade tracker (Nov 2, 2026)

not_included: Bengals and Eagles agreed to an Arnold Ebiketie trade, then Cincinnati called it off (SI and Bleacher Report trackers, Nov 6 to 10): no move.
Teams on a Week 10 bye are not on the card: CHI (Simmons), DEN (Henley), PHI (Davis), TB.
Older in season trades outside the window that are already in the ratings: McCarthy to NYG (Sep 27), Porter to DAL (Sep 30), Jurgens to BAL (Oct 7), Harrison to HOU (Oct 11).
